description.value: K & H Seafood Restaurant is a Chinese seafood dining destination on Kingsway, one of Vancouver's main east-west arterials and a common cycling corridor. The restaurant sits in a dense commercial strip in East Vancouver that serves a large Chinese-Canadian community. Touring cyclists passing through on Kingsway or nearby routes will find a full-service sit-down option for seafood and Chinese cuisine.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kh-chinese.com was blocked by a security system detecting a redirect to a suspicious third-party domain (cf.miniroad.store), rendering website content effectively unavailable for amenity verification. All data therefore relies on OSM tags alone, which confirm a Chinese seafood restaurant at 3415 Kingsway, Vancouver with a phone number and opening hours. No amenity evidence can be drawn from the website.
concerns: Website kh-chinese.com appears compromised: security system detected a redirect to suspicious third-party domain cf.miniroad.store. Website content could not be verified. The URL in OSM should be reviewed and updated if the domain has been taken over or abandoned.
No amenity data could be confirmed due to inaccessible website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational Chinese seafood restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; OSM record is consistent and not flagged as closed.
